sentences.en: who came from England or Scotland to fight in this rebellion, one of whom was Michael Collins, who came back having worked in the post office in London for a while.
sentences.zh: 从英格兰或苏格兰赶来参加这场起义的人，其中就包括迈克尔·柯林斯，他曾在伦敦邮局工作过一段时间后返回。

sentences.en: And they learned the lessons because there had been a dispute in the volunteers before this one, whether they should be going into
sentences.zh: 他们吸取了教训，因为在这之前志愿者内部曾有过一场争论，即他们是否应该进行

sentences.en: a hedge campaign, as in it would be guerrilla warfare.
sentences.zh: 游击战式的丛林战。

sentences.en: But they learned the lessons.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实吸取了教训。

sentences.en: They never set up in the city again.
sentences.zh: 他们再也没有在城市里死守。

sentences.en: They go for guerrilla warfare.
sentences.zh: 他们转而选择了游击战。

sentences.en: And it is the rebels who are from here.
sentences.zh: 正是这些本土的起义者，

sentences.en: They build from this.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上不断发展壮大。

sentences.en: And they build out into success where the idea of anything less than ultimate independence will not be acceptable.
sentences.zh: 最终走向成功，在那里，任何低于最终独立的想法都是不可接受的。

sentences.en: But that is another story.
sentences.zh: 但那是另一个故事了。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 的确如此。

sentences.en: Tom, we will have to, we will clearly have to return to Dublin at some future point to do the
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我们显然必须在未来的某个时候回到都柏林，来讲述

sentences.en: rest of the story, the war of independence, the civil war, Ireland in the 1920s and so on.
sentences.zh: 故事的其余部分——独立战争、内战、20世纪20年代的爱尔兰等等。

sentences.en: I know we also are going to do a series about the troubles at some point.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们迟早也会制作一个关于北爱尔兰冲突的系列节目。

sentences.en: So more Irish history to come.
sentences.zh: 所以未来还会有更多爱尔兰历史内容。

sentences.en: And I hope Joyce.
sentences.zh: 希望还有乔伊斯。

sentences.en: Tom's desperate to do Joyce because Tom wants everybody to know.
sentences.zh: 汤姆迫不及待想讲乔伊斯，因为汤姆想让所有人都知道。

sentences.en: And this is really what this series has been about.
sentences.zh: 这其实也正是本系列节目的意义所在。

sentences.en: This is the, this is the story I want people to take away, isn't it, Tom?
sentences.zh: 这就是我想让听众们记住的故事，对吧，汤姆？

sentences.en: That you once won a t-shirt at a James Joyce pub crawl quiz competition in Dublin.
sentences.zh: 那就是你曾经在都柏林的詹姆斯·乔伊斯酒吧串吧问答竞赛中赢得过一件T恤。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I don't, I don't want that to be the note on which we end, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 但我可不希望我们以这个作为节目的结语，多米尼克。

sentences.en: No, well, it won't be because we should say a massive thank you to Paul Rouse, who has performed manfully.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当然不会，因为我们必须向保罗·劳斯表达由衷的感谢，他表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: We've asked an awful lot of you, Paul, because basically your brief was to do all Irish history.
sentences.zh: 保罗，我们给你布置了一个极其艰巨的任务，因为你基本上得讲完全部的爱尔兰历史。

sentences.en: So thank you so much, not just for your fantastic performance in the episode, but also for your tremendous hospitality here in Dublin.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢你，不仅感谢你在本集中的精彩表现，也感谢你在都柏林给予我们的盛情款待。

sentences.en: And we also did a live show, didn't we, last night,
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚还举办了一场现场演出，对吧，

sentences.en: Tom?
sentences.zh: 汤姆？

sentences.en: So thank you to everybody who came to all our Irish listeners.
sentences.zh: 所以要感谢所有到场的每一位爱尔兰听众。

sentences.en: And also thank you to Angus Lefty, who has provided this room looking out over what was
sentences.zh: 还要感谢安格斯·莱夫蒂，他为我们提供了这个窗外正对着

sentences.en: Sackville Street.
sentences.zh: 萨克维尔街的房间。

sentences.en: It's now O'Connell Street.
sentences.zh: 现在这里叫奥康奈尔街。

sentences.en: And here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们就在这里。

sentences.en: I mean, what better place to have recorded this series than in the GPO itself.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还有什么地方比在总邮局本身录制这个系列更合适呢？

sentences.en: So thank you, Paul.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢你，保罗。

sentences.en: And thank you to everybody for listening.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢所有收听节目的听众。

sentences.en: And goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《历史的余烬》（The Rest is History）。
